debate.key_bull_argument: EMA/MACD golden cross with new 10-day highs and extreme fear sentiment (30/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support at 70.57.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, price below 200-EMA/50-SMA, and lack of ADX/PSAR/AO confirmation expose this as a weak momentum setup in a deteriorating macro environment.
